        mc."REC_PIN",
        COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0) as spoof_pct,

WITH saicomp AS (
    SELECT 
        r."REC_COMP",
        COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0) as spoof_pct,
        COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0) as front_run_val,
        CASE ms."manip_signals"->>'wash_flag' WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Low' THEN 33.33 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 66.67 WHEN 'High' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END as wash_norm,
        CASE ms."layer_idx" WHEN 'None' THEN 0 WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 50 WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END as layer_norm,
        r.behav_score as old_behav_score
    FROM reg_compliance r 
    JOIN market_conditions mc ON r."REC_COMP" = mc."REC_PIN"
    LEFT JOIN manipulation_signals ms ON mc."REC_PIN" = ms."REC_TAG"
    WHERE r.last_rev >= '2024-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    "REC_COMP",
    old_behav_score,
    ROUND(CAST(LEAST(100, (spoof_pct + front_run_val + wash_norm + layer_norm) / 4.0) AS numeric), 2) as new_behav_score
FROM saicomp
ORDER BY ABS(old_behav_score - ROUND(CAST(LEAST(100, (spoof_pct + front_run_val + wash_norm + layer_norm) / 4.0) AS numeric), 2)) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    MIN(COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0)) as min_front,
    MAX(COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0)) as max_front,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0)) as avg_front,
    MIN(COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0)) as min_spoof,
    MAX(COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0)) as max_spoof,
    AVG(COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0)) as avg_spoof
FROM manipulation_signals ms;

SELECT 
    r."REC_COMP",
    r.behav_score,
    COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0) as front_run_val,
    COALESCE(CAST(regexp_replace(ms."manip_signals"->>'spoof_prob', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS real), 0) as spoof_pct,
    ms."layer_idx",
    ms."stuff_idx"
FROM reg_compliance r 
JOIN market_conditions mc ON r."REC_COMP" = mc."REC_PIN"
LEFT JOIN manipulation_signals ms ON mc."REC_PIN" = ms."REC_TAG"
ORDER BY ABS(r.behav_score - COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0))
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    r."REC_COMP",
    r.behav_score,
    COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0) as front_run_val,
    ROUND(CAST(ABS(r.behav_score - COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0)) AS numeric), 4) as diff
FROM reg_compliance r 
JOIN market_conditions mc ON r."REC_COMP" = mc."REC_PIN"
LEFT JOIN manipulation_signals ms ON mc."REC_PIN" = ms."REC_TAG"
WHERE ABS(r.behav_score - COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0)) > 1
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    r."REC_COMP",
    r.behav_score,
    COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0) as front_run_val,
    ms."stuff_idx",
    ms."layer_idx",
    ms."manip_signals"->>'wash_flag' as wash_flag
FROM reg_compliance r 
JOIN market_conditions mc ON r."REC_COMP" = mc."REC_PIN"
LEFT JOIN manipulation_signals ms ON mc."REC_PIN" = ms."REC_TAG"
ORDER BY ABS(r.behav_score - (COALESCE(CAST(ms."manip_signals"->>'front_run' AS real), 0) + COALESCE(ms."stuff_idx", 0) * 100))
LIMIT 10;
